title: UE radio capability information update needed

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed
entities.description: Information element indicating whether the MME shall delete stored UE radio capability information. It is a type 1 information element with a flag indicating update requirement.

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for the UE radio capability information update needed IE, occupying bits 8-6 of octet 1.

entities.name: URC upd
entities.description: UE radio capability information update needed flag in bit 1 of octet 1. Value 0 indicates update not needed, value 1 indicates update needed.

entities.name: URC upd = 0
entities.description: Condition when UE radio capability information update not needed.

entities.name: URC upd = 1
entities.description: Condition when UE radio capability information update needed.

entities.name: MME deletes stored UE radio capability information
entities.description: Behavior where MME deletes stored UE radio capability information when update is needed.

relations.description: The IE contains an Information Element Identifier field.
The IE contains the URC upd flag field.
The URC upd flag value 0 guards the condition that update is not needed.
The URC upd flag value 1 guards the condition that update is needed.
Condition URC upd = 1 establishes that MME shall delete stored UE radio capability information.
